_dukey1215_: On Day 11, Florian Dukey arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Florian Dukey read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The cook borrowed Florian Dukey's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.

A supply man offered Florian Dukey a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. A letter from home reached Florian Dukey before dusk. Florian Dukey read it twice and slept a little easier.
Florian Dukey coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Florian Dukey tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through an operatic duet nobody can translate, spoiling the best part.
Florian Dukey read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
A letter reached Florian Dukey from Stoneyford. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
_hitmanharry_: At the depot, Rafael Hitmanharry had practised answering to his name. At S-C10, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Rafael Hitmanharry let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Jakub Kal (Concord) and Rafael Hitmanharry (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Ossuary Wood on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Rafael Hitmanharry answered to number 782. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Rafael Hitmanharry did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
New laces made Rafael Hitmanharry's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Rafael Hitmanharry and Jonas "Ash" Tomar spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Rafael Hitmanharry borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
Rafael Hitmanharry has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
The dugout has begun inventing endings to Rafael Hitmanharry's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing.
Rafael Hitmanharry and Jonas "Ash" Tomar found a cat in the ruins at Verdel Ridge and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Ash.
actual.red: By the time Wendel Red reached S-F1, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A bullet found Wendel Red at S-F1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._). Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Red. Wendel Red read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F1 with the rations. Wendel Red ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Wendel Red was carried in at last.
A surgeon stopped at Wendel Red's bed, checked the dressing and moved on without a word. He decided that was good news.
Wendel Red came back fit for duty and discovered the section had changed the recipe for its tea. He demanded an explanation.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F1 and grazed Wendel Red's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Pavel Yijoon of the Hegemony (@yijoon09).

Wendel Red came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-F1. Wendel Red has learned to walk bent double.

Wendel Red's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Wendel Red is number 352. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Wendel Red watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Wendel Red traded his brother's pocket watch for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
A second spoon disappeared. Wendel Red searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.

Wendel Red was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F1. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Bastian Abdukarimov of the Hegemony (@xojiakbar.abdukarimov1). Wendel Red was killed at S-F1 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Bastian Abdukarimov of the Hegemony (@xojiakbar.abdukarimov1).
Bastian Red joined S-F1 under the shadow of Wendel Red's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Bastian Red caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.

Bastian Red and Walter Adauto cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. The sappers took Bastian Red in on a busy morning in S-F1. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Bastian Red found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. The corporal called out the mail. Bastian Red heard the name and almost ran.
carlosm.jr: On the way to T-F4, Leopold "Parson" Carlosm tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Leopold "Parson" Carlosm borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold "Parson" Carlosm watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Leopold "Parson" Carlosm heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
Leopold "Parson" Carlosm spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Leopold "Parson" Carlosm had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Edmund Fedakidd was badly wounded.
Across from T-F4, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Leopold "Parson" Carlosm saw it. Silas Monsta was grazed.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Silas "Tin" Roman, grazed. Leopold "Parson" Carlosm cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.

Leopold "Parson" Carlosm did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Leopold "Parson" Carlosm fired back. Tobias Northerncoun was badly wounded. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Leopold "Parson" Carlosm aimed just below it. Matthias Benmarine was badly wounded.
deltascourge1: Bastian Deltascourge came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people. Bastian Deltascourge left the work of a field cook to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Bastian Deltascourge could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Florian "Bones" Peterpopping, grazed. Bastian Deltascourge cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deltascourge. Bastian Deltascourge read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bastian Deltascourge saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F6 and fired once. Casimir Addicted was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deltascourge. Bastian Deltascourge read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet hit Bastian Deltascourge's belt buckle at U-F6 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deltascourge. Bastian Deltascourge read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Back on the fire step at U-F6. Bastian Deltascourge says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deltascourge. Bastian Deltascourge read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Bastian Deltascourge was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. A letter from home reached Bastian Deltascourge before dusk. Bastian Deltascourge read it twice and slept a little easier.

The wound Bastian Deltascourge shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian Deltascourge. Bastian Deltascourge read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
duncan_w_0412: Cyril Duncan found a place in T-F2 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F2. Cyril Duncan has learned to walk bent double.

Cyril Duncan wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Cyril Duncan stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Cyril Duncan ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Cyril Duncan got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Cyril Duncan tried to remember the price of a loaf in Esterhaus. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
A bullet clipped Cyril Duncan's helmet at T-F2 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Silas "Spark" Tallas of the Hegemony (@tallas154).
Cyril Duncan spent the day with his arm in a sling, writing letters for men who cannot write.
Cyril Duncan is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
ethanlam724: At the depot, Gustav Ethanlam had practised answering to his name. At R-S11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Gustav Ethanlam brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Gustav Ethanlam and Jonas "Saint" Carrsonhartw divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Gustav Ethanlam of the Hegemony and Bram Freddie of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Asked what he will do after the war, Gustav Ethanlam said: 'Be a shepherd in Esterhaus. And never complain about anything, ever again.'

The gun at R-S11 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Nils Ewalters, grazed. Blackwater Canal has been won. Gustav Ethanlam listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Gustav Ethanlam helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other. Gustav Ethanlam got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 403. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Gustav Ethanlam folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A bullet grazed Gustav Ethanlam's ribs at R-S11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Bastian Wizzerd of the Concord (@flying_wizzerd).
The medics cleaned Gustav Ethanlam's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-S11.
A bullet went through Gustav Ethanlam's sleeve at R-S11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Florian Warrior of the Concord (@monoliths_greatest_warrior).

A bullet found Gustav Ethanlam at R-S11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Gpt of the Concord (@ghai.gpt). Gustav Ethanlam was killed outright at R-S11, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Ulrich Gpt of the Concord (@ghai.gpt).
Dorian Ethanlam took the same post at R-S11 where Gustav Ethanlam stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Dorian Ethanlam was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S11. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Severin Masterofecli of the Concord (@masterofeclipse). Dorian Ethanlam held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
The papers say Jonas Ethanlam. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Dorian Ethanlam's eyes. Nobody in R-S11 argues.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Jonas Ethanlam put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
iqsanislami: The new sniper gave his name as Felix Iqsanislami. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Felix Iqsanislami shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Felix Iqsanislami reads Ulrich Catshannon's letters from home out loud, because Ulrich never learned to read. Felix leaves out the sad parts. Ulrich knows. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Felix Iqsanislami during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Felix Iqsanislami fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick, now gravely wounded.
Felix Iqsanislami found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: two small boys on a bench, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.

Felix Iqsanislami was hit through the chest at S-R15. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Valentin Coleharrison of the Concord (@coleharrison1210). Felix Iqsanislami was hit at S-R15 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Valentin Coleharrison of the Concord (@coleharrison1210).
Zeno Iqsanislami joined S-R15 under the shadow of Felix Iqsanislami's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Zeno Iqsanislami said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

The men at S-R15 heard Zeno Iqsanislami call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Walter Pst of the Concord (@pst13606). Zeno Iqsanislami was killed at S-R15 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Walter Pst of the Concord (@pst13606).
Lucien "Rabbit" Iqsanislami took the same post at S-R15 where Zeno Iqsanislami stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Silas Michigangame stood up to sing louder, and Lucien "Rabbit" Iqsanislami fired. Silas Michigangame was gravely wounded. The singing stopped. A bullet went into Lucien "Rabbit" Iqsanislami's chest just under the heart at S-R15. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav of the Concord (@olliedav124). A single shot at S-R15. Lucien "Rabbit" Iqsanislami sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav of the Concord (@olliedav124).
Gideon Iqsanislami asked about Lucien "Rabbit" Iqsanislami on arriving at S-R15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
oaustin77: Viktor Oaustin, a lamplighter from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S10. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Viktor Oaustin lost a boot to the mud at R-S10. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fog hid the far end of R-S10. Viktor Oaustin kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Oaustin. Viktor Oaustin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Viktor Oaustin discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
Viktor Oaustin hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S10, Viktor Oaustin listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Viktor Oaustin took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-S10, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Silas "Owl" Monkeycool of the Hegemony (@monkeycool2). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Viktor Oaustin fell at R-S10 and never moved again. Shot by Silas "Owl" Monkeycool of the Hegemony (@monkeycool2).

The papers connected Florian Oaustin to Viktor Oaustin. The men took longer to learn Florian Oaustin's own habits, but they made the effort. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Oaustin is number 381 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Florian Oaustin read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Florian Oaustin and Nils Ewalters carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Florian Oaustin. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Florian Oaustin passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.

Florian Oaustin fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Roland "Mud" Acakostic was gravely wounded. Florian Oaustin ate breakfast without a word. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Florian Oaustin aimed just below it. Nils Oreo was badly wounded.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Bastian Madhornet, grazed. Florian Oaustin cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
A bullet went through Florian Oaustin's sleeve at R-S10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Matthias "Ash" Blasian of the Hegemony (@blasian117).
ratxcatcher420: At the depot, Bram Ratxcatcher had practised answering to his name. At V-F13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Bram Ratxcatcher dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
Bram Ratxcatcher went out with the wiring party at S-S10. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
A flare caught Bram Ratxcatcher halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
Bram Ratxcatcher saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Bram Ratxcatcher began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
streekluukvande: On the way to S-S17, Florian Streekluukva tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Florian Streekluukva discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S17 with the rations. Florian Streekluukva ate while listening to the revised orders.

Florian Streekluukva was hit twice at S-S17, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). Florian Streekluukva was killed at S-S17 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard).

Edmund Streekluukva had heard about Florian Streekluukva's courage. At S-S17, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Edmund Streekluukva got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 591. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S17. Edmund Streekluukva has learned to walk bent double.
A bullet grazed Edmund Streekluukva's ribs at S-S17. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Severin "Crow" Boy of the Hegemony (@st0nk_boy).
Edmund Streekluukva walked back up the communication trench to S-S17, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Edmund Streekluukva reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Gustav Naterrwaterr of the Hegemony (@naterrwaterr).
Three days with a bandage, and Edmund Streekluukva is back at S-S17. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Edmund Streekluukva backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.
Someone asked Edmund Streekluukva to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
sugar_cubes745: On Day 3, Zeno Cubes arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Zeno Cubes put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Officers came to inspect R-F18. Zeno Cubes polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A sniper's bullet hit Zeno Cubes at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Zeno Cubes finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The surgeon worked on Zeno Cubes until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

A letter came with Gideon "Mud" Cubes: "I am Zeno Cubes's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Gideon "Mud" Cubes wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dawn watch. Gideon "Mud" Cubes put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Wendel Yaboyslydude, grazed.
Gideon "Mud" Cubes had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Wendel Yaboyslydude crossed it, Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired. Wendel Yaboyslydude was badly wounded.

Gideon "Mud" Cubes borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Lucien "Shadow" Jro was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Gideon "Mud" Cubes waited for that to change. When it did, Cyril "Brick" Jro was gravely wounded. Gideon "Mud" Cubes fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Pavel Mvuisak, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was hit hard in the fight at R-F18 before anyone could fire. The raider was Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale of the Concord. Raider: Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale of the Concord (@scottjseale). Gideon "Mud" Cubes crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Konrad Rachelejosia reached for a rifle. Gideon "Mud" Cubes was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@rachelejosiah) Gideon "Mud" Cubes threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Quentin "Hollow" Scottjseale was down and screaming for a medic. (@scottjseale) The Hegemony celebrated Gideon "Mud" Cubes's part in winning Blackwater Canal. He sat through the praise with a piece of ration bread still in his pocket.

Gideon "Mud" Cubes spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped. Gideon "Mud" Cubes got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 195. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gideon "Mud" Cubes helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The medics called Gideon "Mud" Cubes 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Gideon "Mud" Cubes is back on the line.
A bullet went through Gideon "Mud" Cubes's sleeve at R-F18 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Bastian Idkvariable of the Concord (@idkvariable).
Gideon "Mud" Cubes returned to R-F18 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

Gideon "Mud" Cubes bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Mud" Cubes. Gideon "Mud" Cubes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The Concord sentry, Edmund Arvidgrubb, shouted once. Gideon "Mud" Cubes silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@arvidgrubb) In the dark of the Concord trench Gideon "Mud" Cubes hit Jonas Utku with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@mustafa1utku) Gideon "Mud" Cubes was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F18. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Pavel Mcm of the Concord (@joe_mcm09).
Gideon "Mud" Cubes died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
The House of Cubes sent Hugo "Hollow" Cubes after Gideon "Mud" Cubes. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
theoneonlyfishboy: Valentin Theoneonlyfi arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Tobias Olly and Valentin Theoneonlyfi argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home reached Valentin Theoneonlyfi before dusk. Valentin Theoneonlyfi read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Valentin Theoneonlyfi looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Valentin Theoneonlyfi was carrying water up to P-F19 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Valentin Theoneonlyfi did not. Shot by Casimir Eclark of the Hegemony (@eclark43). A letter from home reached Valentin Theoneonlyfi before dusk. Valentin Theoneonlyfi read it twice and slept a little easier.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Valentin Theoneonlyfi. He died on the stretcher before morning.

Another member of the House of Theoneonlyfi reached the line: Benedikt Theoneonlyfi. He asked where Valentin Theoneonlyfi had slept, then chose a different corner. Orders assigned Benedikt Theoneonlyfi to work as a rifleman. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Benedikt Theoneonlyfi crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at P-F19 holds again. A letter from home reached Benedikt Theoneonlyfi before dusk. Benedikt Theoneonlyfi read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Theoneonlyfi spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home reached Benedikt Theoneonlyfi before dusk. Benedikt Theoneonlyfi read it twice and slept a little easier.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Benedikt Theoneonlyfi was hit hard in the fight at P-F19 before anyone could fire. The raider was Roland "Mole" Countdooku of the Hegemony. Raider: Roland "Mole" Countdooku of the Hegemony (@countdooku04). The Hegemony sentry, Wendel Ztardvst, shouted once. Benedikt Theoneonlyfi silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@_ztardvst) Benedikt Theoneonlyfi went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Jakub Jay put up a fight, but not for long. (@forever_dm_jay) Benedikt Theoneonlyfi came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. The letter for Benedikt Theoneonlyfi asked if the food was good. Benedikt Theoneonlyfi wrote back that it was. That was a lie, but a kind one.
Three days with a bandage, and Benedikt Theoneonlyfi is back at P-F19. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
tons355: The new sniper gave his name as Yann "Ash" Tons. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Yann "Ash" Tons stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Yann "Ash" Tons began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Yann "Ash" Tons wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The reply to Yann "Ash" Tons's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Yann "Ash" Tons watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Yann "Ash" Tons went out with the wiring party at T-F22. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Yann "Ash" Tons fired once through the steel loophole at T-F22 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Benedikt Clintxix was grazed.
Yann "Ash" Tons came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Yann "Ash" Tons aimed a step ahead and fired: Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu, badly wounded.
txh.__c: By the time Ulrich "Saint" Txh reached N-F15, the war was 13 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Ulrich "Saint" Txh. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Bram "Tin" Iancole snores. Ulrich "Saint" Txh does not. Saint now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Sunken Road every night, fed by Ulrich "Saint" Txh on one side and Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog on the other. The Hegemony call it Patrol. The Concord call it Spy.
Ulrich "Saint" Txh and Bram "Tin" Iancole spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
victor_kabu: Clement Kabu came up on Day 9 carrying news from Port Abel. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Clement Kabu helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Kabu. Clement Kabu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Clement Kabu tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. Clement Kabu got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 823. The men who came later will ask about it. Orders assigned Clement Kabu to work as a stretcher bearer. The first lesson began with what not to touch. Victory at Grey Mill. Clement Kabu let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Clement Kabu and Yann Gastongimene both swear they saw a ghost at the Chalk Pits. Each says the other screamed first. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Kabu. Clement Kabu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A round went through the rim of Clement Kabu's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Florian Wman of the Concord (@bradb0wman).

Clement Kabu walked back up the communication trench to R-C2, slower than before, but on his own feet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement Kabu. Clement Kabu read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Clement Kabu received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.

A muddy dog crawled into R-C2 through the wire. Clement Kabu gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit. A letter for Clement Kabu came all the way from home in nine days. Clement Kabu counted them on the envelope.

Biscuit has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Clement Kabu is very proud. Biscuit is mainly proud of the biscuits. There was a letter for Clement Kabu and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
